ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 70% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity black pigmentation along the perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone; continuous black border along the trailing edge and tips; distinct isolated dark circular focal spot in the mid-lower quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge of the left lobe, characterized by sharp peaks and varied amplitude; partially obscured on the right lobe by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve observed on the outer margin of the left lobe tapering towards the tip; right lobe sweep is obscured by splash and camera angle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single high-contrast dark circular cluster located in the mid-white field of the left lobe; smaller dark mottling clusters near the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged irregularities on the distal tip of the left lobe suggesting past physical trauma or heavy wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant diagonal white-water spray occluding the central median notch and the proximal base of the fluke.
